judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass H.R. 5, the Equality Act, which added sexual orientation and gender identity to the categories protected from discrimination in employment, housing, credit, education, jury service, and public accommodations. It passed the House 224-206.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against passing H.R. 5, the Equality Act, which added sexual orientation and gender identity to the categories protected from discrimination in employment, housing, credit, education, jury service, and public accommodations. It passed the House 224-206.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass H.R. 803, the Protecting America's Wilderness and Public Lands Act, which designated new wilderness, conservation, and recreation areas on federal land across eight states and the Virgin Islands. It passed the House 227-200.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against passing H.R. 803, the Protecting America's Wilderness and Public Lands Act, which designated new wilderness, conservation, and recreation areas on federal land across eight states and the Virgin Islands. It passed the House 227-200.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass H.R. 1280, the George Floyd Justice in Policing Act, which restricted chokeholds and no-knock warrants, narrowed qualified immunity for officers, and created national standards and misconduct reporting for police. It passed the House 220-212.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against passing H.R. 1280, the George Floyd Justice in Policing Act, which restricted chokeholds and no-knock warrants, narrowed qualified immunity for officers, and created national standards and misconduct reporting for police. It passed the House 220-212.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass H.R. 1319, the American Rescue Plan Act, the $1.9 trillion COVID-19 relief package that sent $1,400 payments to most households, extended jobless benefits, expanded the child tax credit, and funded vaccines, schools, and state governments. It passed the Senate 50-49.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against passing H.R. 1319, the American Rescue Plan Act, the $1.9 trillion COVID-19 relief package that sent $1,400 payments to most households, extended jobless benefits, expanded the child tax credit, and funded vaccines, schools, and state governments. It passed the Senate 50-49.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to send H.R. 1319, the American Rescue Plan Act, to the President, agreeing to the Senate's version of the $1.9 trillion COVID-19 relief package that sent $1,400 payments to most households, extended jobless benefits, expanded the child tax credit, and funded vaccines and schools. It passed the House 220-211.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against sending H.R. 1319, the American Rescue Plan Act, to the President, which agreed to the Senate's version of the $1.9 trillion COVID-19 relief package that sent $1,400 payments to most households, extended jobless benefits, expanded the child tax credit, and funded vaccines and schools. It passed the House 220-211.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass H.R. 8, the Bipartisan Background Checks Act, which required a licensed dealer to run a background check on nearly every private firearm sale or transfer, including at gun shows and online. It passed the House 227-203.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against passing H.R. 8, the Bipartisan Background Checks Act, which required a licensed dealer to run a background check on nearly every private firearm sale or transfer, including at gun shows and online. It passed the House 227-203.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass H.R. 1446, the Enhanced Background Checks Act, which extended the time a dealer must wait for a completed background check from three business days to at least ten, closing the so-called Charleston loophole. It passed the House 219-210.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against passing H.R. 1446, the Enhanced Background Checks Act, which extended the time a dealer must wait for a completed background check from three business days to at least ten, closing the so-called Charleston loophole. It passed the House 219-210.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass H.J.Res. 17, which removed the ratification deadline for the Equal Rights Amendment, the constitutional amendment barring discrimination on account of sex. It passed the House 222-204.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against passing H.J.Res. 17, which removed the ratification deadline for the Equal Rights Amendment, the constitutional amendment barring discrimination on account of sex. It passed the House 222-204.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass H.R. 1620, the Violence Against Women Act Reauthorization, which renewed federal programs against domestic violence, sexual assault, and stalking through 2026 and added housing protections and firearm restrictions for convicted abusers. It passed the House 244-172.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against passing H.R. 1620, the Violence Against Women Act Reauthorization, which renewed federal programs against domestic violence, sexual assault, and stalking through 2026 and added housing protections and firearm restrictions for convicted abusers. It passed the House 244-172.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass H.R. 6, the American Dream and Promise Act, which offered permanent resident status to immigrants brought to the country as children and to people holding Temporary Protected Status or Deferred Enforced Departure. It passed the House 228-197.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against passing H.R. 6, the American Dream and Promise Act, which offered permanent resident status to immigrants brought to the country as children and to people holding Temporary Protected Status or Deferred Enforced Departure. It passed the House 228-197.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass H.R. 1603, the Farm Workforce Modernization Act, which created a certified agricultural worker status for undocumented farmworkers and a path to permanent residence, and reworked the H-2A seasonal visa program. It passed the House 247-174.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against passing H.R. 1603, the Farm Workforce Modernization Act, which created a certified agricultural worker status for undocumented farmworkers and a path to permanent residence, and reworked the H-2A seasonal visa program. It passed the House 247-174.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass H.R. 1868, which extended the exemption shielding Medicare from automatic across-the-board sequestration cuts through the end of 2021. It passed the House 246-175.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against passing H.R. 1868, which extended the exemption shielding Medicare from automatic across-the-board sequestration cuts through the end of 2021. It passed the House 246-175.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass H.R. 7, the Paycheck Fairness Act, which narrowed the defenses an employer can raise for paying men and women differently, barred retaliation against workers who discuss pay, and strengthened remedies in wage discrimination cases. It passed the House 217-210.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against passing H.R. 7, the Paycheck Fairness Act, which narrowed the defenses an employer can raise for paying men and women differently, barred retaliation against workers who discuss pay, and strengthened remedies in wage discrimination cases. It passed the House 217-210.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass H.R. 1333, the NO BAN Act, which limited the President's power to bar entry to the United States and prohibited religious discrimination in visa and immigration decisions. It passed the House 218-208.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against passing H.R. 1333, the NO BAN Act, which limited the President's power to bar entry to the United States and prohibited religious discrimination in visa and immigration decisions. It passed the House 218-208.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass H.R. 1573, the Access to Counsel Act, which gave citizens, green card holders, visa holders, and returning refugees the right to consult a lawyer when held for secondary inspection at a port of entry. It passed the House 217-207.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against passing H.R. 1573, the Access to Counsel Act, which gave citizens, green card holders, visa holders, and returning refugees the right to consult a lawyer when held for secondary inspection at a port of entry. It passed the House 217-207.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass S.J.Res. 14, which used the Congressional Review Act to repeal the 2020 EPA rule that had removed methane emission limits from new and modified oil and gas sources, restoring those standards. It passed the Senate 52-42.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against passing S.J.Res. 14, which used the Congressional Review Act to repeal the 2020 EPA rule that had removed methane emission limits from new and modified oil and gas sources, restoring those standards. It passed the Senate 52-42.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass H.R. 1629, the Fairness in Orphan Drug Exclusivity Act, which narrowed the rare-disease drugs eligible for seven years of FDA market exclusivity to those that are not expected to be profitable. Brought up under suspension of the rules, it fell short of the required two thirds, 250-168.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against passing H.R. 1629, the Fairness in Orphan Drug Exclusivity Act, which narrowed the rare-disease drugs eligible for seven years of FDA market exclusivity to those that are not expected to be profitable. Brought up under suspension of the rules, it fell short of the required two thirds, 250-168.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass S.J.Res. 15, which used the Congressional Review Act to repeal the Comptroller of the Currency's true lender rule, a rule that let national banks be named as lender on loans funded by others and so shield them from state interest rate caps. It passed the Senate 52-47.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against passing S.J.Res. 15, which used the Congressional Review Act to repeal the Comptroller of the Currency's true lender rule, a rule that let national banks be named as lender on loans funded by others and so shield them from state interest rate caps. It passed the Senate 52-47.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass H.R. 2547, the Comprehensive Debt Collection Improvement Act, which restricted debt collection practices, extended student loan protections to private loans, and limited collection on servicemembers and medical debt. It passed the House 215-207.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against passing H.R. 2547, the Comprehensive Debt Collection Improvement Act, which restricted debt collection practices, extended student loan protections to private loans, and limited collection on servicemembers and medical debt. It passed the House 215-207.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass H.R. 1065, the Pregnant Workers Fairness Act, which required employers to make reasonable accommodations for workers affected by pregnancy or childbirth. It passed the House 315-101.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against passing H.R. 1065, the Pregnant Workers Fairness Act, which required employers to make reasonable accommodations for workers affected by pregnancy or childbirth. It passed the House 315-101.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass H.R. 1187, the Corporate Governance Improvement and Investor Protection Act, which required public companies to disclose climate risk, political spending, executive pay, and other environmental, social, and governance measures. It passed the House 215-214.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against passing H.R. 1187, the Corporate Governance Improvement and Investor Protection Act, which required public companies to disclose climate risk, political spending, executive pay, and other environmental, social, and governance measures. It passed the House 215-214.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass H.R. 256, which repealed the 2002 authorization for the use of military force against Iraq, withdrawing the standing legal basis for military action there. It passed the House 268-161.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against passing H.R. 256, which repealed the 2002 authorization for the use of military force against Iraq, withdrawing the standing legal basis for military action there. It passed the House 268-161.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass H.R. 2062, the Protecting Older Workers Against Discrimination Act, which let workers win an age discrimination claim by showing age was a motivating factor rather than the sole cause. It passed the House 247-178.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against passing H.R. 2062, the Protecting Older Workers Against Discrimination Act, which let workers win an age discrimination claim by showing age was a motivating factor rather than the sole cause. It passed the House 247-178.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to send S.J.Res. 15 to the President, using the Congressional Review Act to repeal the Comptroller of the Currency's true lender rule, a rule that let national banks be named as lender on loans funded by others and so shield them from state interest rate caps. It passed the House 218-208.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against sending S.J.Res. 15 to the President, which used the Congressional Review Act to repeal the Comptroller of the Currency's true lender rule, a rule that let national banks be named as lender on loans funded by others and so shield them from state interest rate caps. It passed the House 218-208.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass H.R. 1443, the LGBTQ Business Equal Credit Enforcement and Investment Act, which required lenders to report credit application data for LGBTQ-owned businesses so fair lending laws can be enforced. It passed the House 252-176.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against passing H.R. 1443, the LGBTQ Business Equal Credit Enforcement and Investment Act, which required lenders to report credit application data for LGBTQ-owned businesses so fair lending laws can be enforced. It passed the House 252-176.
